name: Tithes And Offerings
overview: Scripture teaches that tithes and offerings are sacred, belonging to the Lord as a holy portion set apart from the increase of the land and personal substance (Leviticus 27:30; Proverbs 3:9). The giving of a tenth serves both as an act of worship and practical support for those who minister in God's house, such as the Levites (Numbers 18:21; Malachi 3:10). The failure to bring tithes and offerings is equated with robbing God, highlighting the seriousness of this responsibility (Malachi 3:8). While the law emphasizes faithful giving, it also calls believers to uphold justice, mercy, and faith, showing that generosity must accompany a life marked by righteousness (Matthew 23:23).
